turns.reply:
It changes both! 

Building muscle requires a slight calorie surplus so your body has the extra energy and raw materials to build new tissue instead of burning fat.

Your targets will adjust so you're eating a bit more food to support growth and recovery, while your training shifts toward volume and rep ranges for muscle size.

Once you tap confirm on the card, your meals and targets will update automatically alongside your new training block.
